TEXT.English: Steal research for one randomly chosen technology. More available technologies improve returns; additional sources have diminishing returns.

TEXT.English: Build a military network over time to strengthen your troops, infiltrate besieged cities and track enemy troop movements. Networks decay without funding.
TEXT.French: Développez un réseau militaire pour renforcer vos troupes, infiltrer les villes assiégées et suivre les troupes adverses. Sans financement, le réseau décline.
TEXT.German: Bauen Sie ein Militärnetz auf, das Ihre Truppen stärkt, belagerte Städte infiltriert und feindliche Truppenbewegungen aufklärt. Ohne Finanzierung verfällt das Netz.
TEXT.Italian: Sviluppa una rete militare per rafforzare le truppe, infiltrare le città assediate e seguire i movimenti nemici. Senza fondi, la rete si indebolisce.
TEXT.Spanish: Desarrolla una red militar para reforzar tus tropas, infiltrar ciudades sitiadas y seguir movimientos enemigos. Sin fondos, la red se debilita.

TEXT.English: Build political pressure that reduces stability, can provoke local unrest and prolongs civic-change anarchy. Larger populations resist more effectively.
TEXT.French: Build political pressure that reduces stability, can provoke local unrest and prolongs civic-change anarchy. Larger populations resist more effectively.

TEXT.Spanish: Build political pressure that reduces stability, can provoke local unrest and prolongs civic-change anarchy. Larger populations resist more effectively.

TEXT.English: Combined pressure causes at most -6 stability and +2 anarchy turns at Normal speed, or +4 on XL. Unrest causes +2 unhappiness for 2 Normal turns or 4 XL turns. Pressure recovers after operations stop.

TEXT.German: Gemeinsamer Druck verursacht höchstens -6 Stabilität und +2 Runden Anarchie bei normalem Tempo, auf XL +4. Unruhen verursachen +2 Unzufriedenheit für 2 normale oder 4 XL-Runden. Nach Ende der Operation sinkt der Druck.
TEXT.Italian: La pressione totale causa al massimo -6 stabilità e +2 turni di anarchia a velocità normale, o +4 su XL. I disordini causano +2 infelicità per 2 turni normali o 4 turni XL. La pressione cala al termine delle operazioni.
TEXT.Spanish: La presión total causa como máximo -6 estabilidad y +2 turnos de anarquía a velocidad normal, o +4 en XL. Los disturbios causan +2 infelicidad durante 2 turnos normales o 4 turnos XL. La presión baja al terminar las operaciones.
